as_read: Mixed: small positive cognition trials at higher powder amounts, null or task-specific acute results, and no chronic trial of an extract at the labels' amounts.

studies_to_add.primary_endpoint: not named; MMSE, Benton and verbal paired-associate tests
studies_to_add.quote: MMSE alone showed that oral intake of H. erinaceus significantly improved cognitive functions and prevented from the deterioration.

studies_to_add.primary_endpoint: not named; cognition, stress and mood
studies_to_add.quote: However, null and limited negative findings were also observed.

studies_to_add.primary_endpoint: not named; composite cognition and mood
studies_to_add.quote: In conclusion, acute consumption of H. erinaceus fruiting body did not demonstrate a significant overall improvement in cognitive performance and mood compared to the placebo and any benefits may be task or domain specific.

stored_rating_note: positive_moderate rests on one 30-person trial with a post-stopping fall in scores; too strong. Stored study_type and direction don't reflect the small size. The labels print extract or 1 g powder, not the tablets at 3 g/day.
unread_notes: Abstracts only; 31413233 has no amount or sample size in the abstract, and its full text wasn't opened, so its dose is extraction_pending. 3932005 (1985, chronic atrophic gastritis) has no abstract on PubMed and is not cited. Other search listings were narrative reviews or blends.
